groups.title: Complete Advent of Ascension
groups.summary: A finished original mod, not an endlessly running converter demonstration.

items.title: Source lineage and original identity
items.acceptance: Use the accepted union of authoritative AoA source and content, retain fingerprints, mod name/public IDs and approved migrations, and continue the active project rather than choosing a smaller branch or renamed fork.

items.title: Complete semantic port
items.acceptance: Complete every requested target's code, registries, loader APIs, networking, optional integrations and persistence through reproducible Enderloom/Dev Kit transformations.

items.title: Complete gameplay and assets
items.acceptance: Account for all accepted items, blocks, equipment, skills, progression, dimensions, structures, mobs, bosses, AI, models, animation, audio, particles, recipes, loot and tags; no substitutes, hidden omissions or placeholders.

items.title: Native gameplay and migration proof
items.acceptance: Exercise the full applicable client, dedicated/integrated server, unique mechanics, dimension travel, provider-present/absent and save/restart/migration inventory on the actual packaged artifact.

items.title: Clean conversion replay
items.acceptance: Reproduce from original inputs in a fresh generated workspace, with exact dependencies, reusable fixes and equivalent-work performance; no hand-fixed target tree or developer-global tools.

items.title: AoA delivered through the studio
items.acceptance: Ship installable complete source/mod outputs and evidence; the real AoA project opens, converts, repairs, builds, play-tests and installs safely through normal studio controls.

groups.title: Beautiful unified studio
groups.summary: Welcoming on the surface; professional depth one click away.

items.title: Four-action Home
items.acceptance: Create a Mod, Convert to Version, Repair / Fix Issues and Improve Performance are obvious production actions beside import/drop, useful empty states and real recent-project previews.

items.title: One contextual workbench
items.acceptance: One Studio contains persistent resizable content tree/outliner, center viewport/editor, contextual inspector, timeline, source/debug panes and collapsible details; project types are contexts, not disconnected studios.

items.title: Finished visual system
items.acceptance: Apply cohesive graphite/plum/amethyst and equally complete light/dark/system themes, readable typography, consistent icons/spacing/elevation/focus, purposeful motion and native window chrome across every screen.

items.title: Discoverable contextual actions
items.acceptance: Global command palette, contextual search, shallow navigation, keyboard alternatives, accurate tooltips, meaningful next actions and exact deep links connect projects, mods, issues, configs, evidence and outputs.

items.title: Honest progress and live findings
items.acceptance: Real stages/events, task graph, current action, per-item results, repair iterations and useful findings remain visible; logs are secondary and percentages never fabricate knowledge.

items.title: Reliable editing and recovery
items.acceptance: Autosave, undo/redo, dirty-state indicators, snapshots, unsaved-change guards, conflict detection and restart restoration preserve selection, editor tabs, target and job state.

items.title: Large-data and bulk usability
items.acceptance: Search, counts, filters, sorting, select-all, tagging and batch operations address the entire logical dataset; virtualized views do not cap results or drop errors.

items.title: Accessible responsive native UI
items.acceptance: Verify both themes, contrast/focus/non-color status, screen-reader names, reduced motion, keyboard operation, specified desktop/portrait sizes and scaling without clipping primary actions.

items.title: First-launch and update experience
items.acceptance: First launch provisions ordinary requirements with minimal questions; upgrades preserve projects/preferences/accounts/jobs; loading, empty, error and offline states remain actionable and polished.

items.title: Real-user journey acceptance
items.acceptance: Exercise all four journeys in the actual package with clean inputs, real domain services, native runtime, persisted state and rollback; capture real screens, not mockups or generated showcase imagery.

groups.title: Authoring and real assets
groups.summary: Visual creation and expert code operate on the same editable project.

items.title: Arbitrary native mod creation
items.acceptance: Create blank, starter or imported projects with functioning content, stable identity, build/test setup and source escape hatches; templates and block/item examples are not the ceiling.

items.title: Safe visual and code round-tripping
items.acceptance: Visual properties, source editor, language tooling and semantic representation stay connected; user code/unknown syntax remains recoverable without silently losing build or conversion behavior.

items.title: Items, blocks and equipment editors
items.acceptance: Author materials, states, tools, armor, equipment and inventories with target-aware properties, references and in-game proof.

items.title: Entities, bosses and gameplay graphs
items.acceptance: Author entities, AI/events/procedures, interaction, combat, progression and custom systems with meaningful behavior and network/persistence validation, not empty registrations.

items.title: Recipes, loot, tags and data editing
items.acceptance: Use visual recipes and structured validated data editors, reference navigation, error repair, target schemas and deterministic datagen without dropping unknown fields.

items.title: World, biome, structure and dimension authoring
items.acceptance: Preview and edit world content with source-linked generation rules, safe native testing and full worldgen/structure/dimension semantics.

items.title: Model, UV and texture fidelity
items.acceptance: Support relevant model codecs, cubes/planes/meshes, hierarchy, pivots/locators, per-face rotated/flipped UVs, texture layers and pixel-correct editing without geometric simplification.

items.title: Animation, Molang, effects and audio
items.acceptance: Timeline/scrubbing, easing/interpolation, expressions/scopes, locators, sounds/particles/custom tracks and real audio playback preserve behavior, timing and thread isolation.

items.title: Reference and concept reconstruction
items.acceptance: Lawfully ingest images/GIFs/models/server resources, distinguish observed/inferred/authored facts, reconstruct from multiple views/times, preserve intended Minecraft style and verify native visuals.

items.title: Compound content and ecosystem integration
items.acceptance: Build interacting content families with version-specific integrations, edit/play/rebuild and convert them; a decorative block or asset pack alone is not a complete created mod.

items.title: Real preview and native comparison
items.acceptance: Viewport orbit/pan/zoom, orthographic/perspective, texture/UV/material inspection and native captures use actual project assets; clearly separate preview approximations from native runtime proof.

groups.title: Universal conversion engine
groups.summary: One semantic project; the strongest proven backend for each real target.

items.title: Input and source authority
items.acceptance: Identify repositories/folders/source archives/JARs/Bedrock/plugin packs by real identity and lineage; inventory before execution, deduplicate identical imports and retain originals.

items.title: Universal semantic representation
items.acceptance: Represent code, behavior, content, assets, dependencies and lineage once; preserve unknown constructs and generate version/loader/edition adapters without cloning disconnected mod projects.

items.title: Live version and toolchain atlas
items.acceptance: Enumerate the full actual version/loader catalogue, including historical and preview distinctions, runtime/build JVM constraints and future published metadata; never invent support or impose one backend's limited matrix.

items.title: Exact mappings and symbol truth
items.acceptance: Descriptor/owner/hierarchy/overload-aware mappings, classpath/JAR validation and API deltas distinguish exact symbols, candidates and unresolved semantics with source evidence.

items.title: Source migration and semantic repair
items.acceptance: Apply structured Java/Kotlin/AST/source-range transformations, version-hop rules, metadata/resources/build/config changes and stronger equivalents; do not trust global text replacement.

items.title: Mixin, access and reflection correctness
items.acceptance: Remap and prove selectors, injections, locals/slices/ordinals, refmaps, AW/AT/ClassTweaker, interface/enum changes and reflection/MethodHandles in the actual packaged loader.

items.title: JAR recovery and binary repair
items.acceptance: Preserve original binaries, use differential decompilers/remappers/constant evidence, reconcile signatures/control flow/resources and verify signed/multi-release/nested JAR behavior.

items.title: Modern and historical build matrix
items.acceptance: Integrate appropriate Stonecutter/Modstitch/official/Architectury/Unimined/RFG routes, immutable workspaces, target-first scheduling and correct legacy/JVM backport support.

items.title: Native loader and compatibility modes
items.acceptance: Translate loader semantics with real Sinytra/Kilt/Porting-Lib/Architectury evidence; explicitly distinguish native source ports, modified JARs and compatibility runtimes.

items.title: Complete cross-edition conversion
items.acceptance: Convert Java/Bedrock logic as well as resources, manifests, scripts, entities/events/components/Molang/world rules; a visual pack or stubbed method never satisfies gameplay conversion.

items.title: Authorized server content to native mod
items.acceptance: Separate visual/model-runtime/gameplay source layers, recover supplied plugin/resource configurations and ship native behavior without requiring the original commercial server stack.

items.title: Incremental matrix and packaging
items.acceptance: Cache exact valid inputs/results, build independent cells safely, retry only invalidated cells, preserve per-cell artifacts and test optional merged packaging in every claimed included runtime.

items.title: Conversion parity and clean replay
items.acceptance: Compare source-authoritative IDs, graphs and semantics, not output-derived counters; unresolved/unread content fails certification; reproduce from original inputs through the normal toolchain.

items.title: Ecosystem backend integration
items.acceptance: Production-wire selected researched tools or stronger proven equivalents; retain attribution and project-specific permissions, execute comparison fixtures and record exact versions/capabilities/dispositions.

groups.title: Dependencies and shared operations
groups.summary: The app finds the requirements and resumes the original job.

items.title: Full dependency closure
items.acceptance: Resolve source/target/transitive/nested/build/runtime/client/server and optional dependencies together, preserving ranges, provider identity, hashes and semantic target-side equivalents.

items.title: Automatic safe acquisition
items.acceptance: Fetch ordinary compatible requirements through authorized routes, verify complete bytes, resume interrupted downloads and original jobs; explain provider challenges without bypassing them.

items.title: Conflict and change-impact graph
items.acceptance: Explain diamonds/cycles/conflicts, dependents, world/config/benchmark impact and why a component is installed; no arbitrary replacement, constraint relaxation or silent dependency deletion.

items.title: Managed immutable toolchains
items.acceptance: Provision versioned JDKs/Gradle/loaders/tools, single-flight shared downloads and fingerprints, isolate tool versus game runtimes and reuse verified offline cache without developer-global assumptions.

items.title: Canonical identity and action registry
items.acceptance: GUI/CLI/MCP/agents share stable project/artifact/instance/provider identities and typed operations, with no private bypass or duplicate resolver/state owner.

items.title: Staged transactions and concurrent safety
items.acceptance: Use immutable inputs, owned staging, revision/hash guards, atomic promotion, scoped rollback and late-worker rejection; preserve external files and concurrent Codex/user edits.

items.title: Durable jobs and cancellation
items.acceptance: Persist operation/process identities, completed-stage fingerprints, logs, retries and exact next action across restart; cancel only owned work and never promote partial outputs.

items.title: Adapter proof and truthful failures
items.acceptance: Probe actual CLI/library contracts and pair-specific fixtures; reject exit-zero/no-output/stale/malformed reports, distinguish unknown from absent and route failed backends to real recovery.

groups.title: Repair and forensics
groups.summary: Fix the causal owner, retain content, and prove the repaired result.

items.title: Root-cause repair workflow
items.acceptance: Attach logs to correct input/run, identify earliest failure, show concise findings, apply scoped fixes and validate; Fix/Fix Issues/View Changes/Undo are real operations.

items.title: Reusable diagnostics adapters
items.acceptance: Version-aware adapter catalog, analyzer selection, shared evidence and auto-provisioning in owned test clones select appropriate tools for crashes, TPS, FPS, memory and loading.

items.title: Crash, linkage, data and configuration repair
items.acceptance: Repair real loader/dependency/Mixin/registration/data/resource/config faults without suppressing diagnostics, wholesale disabling or content deletion.

items.title: Freeze, lock and concurrency forensics
items.acceptance: Correlate threads, dumps, deadlocks/races, locks and runtime phase; repair causal concurrency while preserving semantics, with failing-before/passing-after fixtures.

items.title: Heap and memory-leak diagnosis
items.acceptance: Capture useful allocation/retention/GC evidence, reproduce growth and fix ownership/lifecycle leaks with equivalent-work soak validation.

items.title: Black Box incident timeline
items.acceptance: Owned bounded rolling evidence, meaningful triggers and cross-tool timeline preserve causal context with export/privacy controls; not a hidden perpetual patching watchdog.

items.title: Dependency-safe bisect and reproducer
items.acceptance: Isolate faults using dependency closure, controlled scenarios and delta debugging, retain source content and deliver a working minimized reproduction with provenance.

items.title: Generalized repair knowledge
items.acceptance: Every nontrivial verified fix becomes a scoped reusable transformation/incident recipe with negative regressions, applicability/invalidation and clean replay; no hidden hand-patched outputs.

groups.title: Native testing and control plane
groups.summary: Cheap decisive checks during iteration; strongest required proof at certification.

items.title: Deterministic test sandbox
items.acceptance: Clone/snapshot only into Enderloom-owned test space, never benchmark live saves; fingerprint full mods/config/world/scenario/Java/loader/hardware conditions.

items.title: Scenario and GameTest compiler
items.acceptance: Unify declarative startup/idle/traversal/stress/soak/gameplay scenarios, setup/teardown/assertions, GameTest adapters and deterministic replay across supported targets.

items.title: Runtime supervision and automation
items.acceptance: Control real client/dedicated/integrated/Bedrock processes, commands/RCON, readiness, isolated accounts where appropriate, cancellation and restart with exact process/build identity.

items.title: Full CLI, JSON and MCP parity
items.acceptance: Expose every accepted domain command and job/evidence operation headlessly through the same service layer, structured events/errors/cancellation, recordable replay and CI integration.

items.title: Artifact-bound native proof
items.acceptance: Bind native runs/logs/captures to exact hashes/target/dependencies; verify gameplay and persistence, not only build/menu/server-ready or a script named runtime.

items.title: Compatibility and hostile fixtures
items.acceptance: Select full applicable ecosystem, provider-present/absent, platform, source/JAR, data/world, cross-loader/direction and false-success tests without sampling away required scope.

items.title: Results and repeatability
items.acceptance: Keep baseline/candidate history, current/stale/confidence states, logs/profiles/screens and reproducible actions; targeted invalidation reuses only still-valid proof.

items.title: Machine-verifiable release gates
items.acceptance: Fail on missing/skipped/stale/wrong-artifact evidence, no-op production paths, partial parity or unjustified demotion; a checklist tick alone cannot satisfy certification.

groups.title: Performance without loss
groups.summary: Optimize measured work, not the amount of content or verification.

items.title: Real mod and instance optimization
items.acceptance: Profile and repair dominant CPU/tick/render/worldgen/memory/I/O costs, apply reversible changes and retest; recommendations alone do not count as Optimize.

items.title: Minimal measurement and rich attribution
items.acceptance: Separate low-overhead measurements from diagnostic runs; integrate native telemetry/JFR/spark/Observable/probes and correlate causality without misreporting overhead as mod cost.

items.title: Controlled A/B and full-pack attribution
items.acceptance: Use equivalent fingerprints, dependency-safe with/without plans, repeated samples, variance/confidence and stale-baseline detection; static risk is not measured causality.

items.title: Frame-time and GPU lab
items.acceptance: Measure distributions/stutters/render-thread/GPU behavior in real native scenarios; fix hot paths without reducing visual fidelity, shaders, distance, geometry or animation cadence.

items.title: Boot and fast-launch engine
items.acceptance: Reuse verified immutable setup and classpath/toolchain/asset caches, profile startup phases and preserve full required initialization; no fake faster launch by skipping work.

items.title: Memory, tick and throughput gains
items.acceptance: Report allocation/GC/memory/MSPT/TPS/load/throughput as relevant, repair regressions and show per-lane results instead of averages hiding loss.

items.title: Fast conversion and responsive studio
items.acceptance: Single-flight/index/cache/batch/diff-aware workers improve first useful result and end-to-end latency with bounded resources; meet measured local UI budgets without reduced result sets.

items.title: Dedicated Performance workspace
items.acceptance: Provide understandable before/after charts, conditions, bottlenecks, scenario control, drill-down and exact optimize/rollback actions in the dedicated first-class surface.

items.title: Dual quality and speed acceptance
items.acceptance: Demonstrate material repeatable improvement on required fixtures and preservation of full content/correctness/compatibility/verification; repair mixed regressions and never invent gains for already-optimal cases.

groups.title: Discovery, favorites and content
groups.summary: Research a project, act on it, and return to its evidence without losing context.

items.title: Broad source-aware discovery
items.acceptance: Preserve the full provider universe and real project identities, source links, creator attribution, all logical results and source health; native APIs/session-aware fallbacks remain truthful.

items.title: Correct premium media and trailers
items.acceptance: Keep project icons/avatars/gallery/post/video roles distinct, exact-project ownership, full-resolution media/lightbox and source-grounded autoplay trailer preferences; no synthetic replacements or unrelated promotions.

items.title: Real embedded browser
items.acceptance: Preserve Chromium tabs, persistent authorized sessions, real login, split/full/source modes, filtered networking and safe translation/original toggles without fake static pages.

items.title: Catalog-to-instance bridge
items.acceptance: Install from research, choose exact compatible versions and multiple instances, review dependencies and reopen focused research from installed content.

items.title: Dedicated Favorites workspace
items.acceptance: Favorites independent of installation, tags/groups/notes, grid/list/table, full-dataset bulk actions, latest/tested/installed states and exact-context actions persist; unfavorite never uninstalls.

items.title: Content lifecycle and provenance
items.acceptance: Manage mods/resource packs/shaders/data packs, manual and provider-backed content, enable/disable/remove/update with snapshots, dependents, exact file hashes and preserved local configs.

items.title: Exact versions, freeze and upgrades
items.acceptance: Search full compatible/incompatible version choices, changelogs, pin/freeze/unfreeze and rollback; frozen content stays fixed unless explicitly changed.

items.title: Provider downloads and account recovery
items.acceptance: Respect author-disabled third-party downloads, safe browser handoff and verified adoption, reconnect legitimate sessions and resume exact jobs without guessed identities or bypass.

items.title: Pack and research interchange
items.acceptance: Support accepted MRPack/CurseForge ZIP/packwiz and CSV/JSON/XLSX/HTML/PDF research interchange with provenance, original fields and clickable links; no cloned proprietary share-code service.

groups.title: Launcher, accounts and instances
groups.summary: Keep the existing launcher and catalogue working while the studio grows.

items.title: External-launcher connection in place
items.acceptance: Discover real CurseForge/Modrinth/accepted launcher instances, identify junctions physically, connect without forced copy, reconcile moves and disconnect without deleting external files.

items.title: Instance creation and organization
items.acceptance: Create vanilla/loader/imported instances, persistent aliases/groups/tags/favorites/views/reordering/search/bulk operations and transactional cancellation; cloning is explicit and verified.

items.title: Secure Microsoft accounts and appearance
items.acceptance: Real authorized login/entitlements/token refresh, OS-backed secret storage, account switching and polished skin/cape library/3D preview preserve supported official operations.

items.title: Java, loaders and real launch
items.acceptance: Discover/install correct Java/loaders, configure memory/arguments/environment, launch the actual game and supervise logs/processes with identity-checked termination and restart adoption.

items.title: Instance update and maintenance
items.acceptance: Show change impact, local/manual content, exact dependencies, disk use and maintenance actions with pre-change backups, rollback and user-config preservation.

items.title: Native sharing and pack distribution
items.acceptance: Provide authorized export/import/delta/share workflows from stable identities and hashes while preserving local overlays; do not impersonate proprietary cloud features.

groups.title: Configuration, hotkeys and progression
groups.summary: Turn obscure settings and conflicts into clear, reversible actions.

items.title: Semantic config intelligence
items.acceptance: Discover file/owner/scope/schema identity, explain known settings, three-way migrate upstream default/old default/user overrides and preserve comments/unknown fields where formats permit.

items.title: Config profiles, overlays and repair
items.acceptance: Apply scoped profiles and performance-linked changes transactionally, validate diffs, diagnose bad config without blanket deletion and preserve user intent across versions.

items.title: Dedicated Hotkeys top-level tab
items.acceptance: Inventory full bindings with owner/default/current/context, find real conflicts, rebind/reset and manage profiles/import/export/migration with correct runtime/UI integration.

items.title: Data, functions and command debugger
items.acceptance: Provide target-aware parser/diagnostics, execution traces/watches/state diff, supported breakpoint-like behavior, command-block graphs and deterministic regression generation.

items.title: Scripted modpack logic
items.acceptance: Integrate relevant KubeJS/CraftTweaker/Bedrock script bridges, source/owner links and safe tested changes; never run untrusted scripts merely to inspect inputs.

items.title: Progression and softlock intelligence
items.acceptance: Analyze quest/recipe/loot/unlock dependencies, detect reachability and progression traps, explain causes and verify fixes in actual gameplay.

groups.title: Worlds, servers and migration
groups.summary: Preserve Forever Worlds, external ownership and every meaningful migration field.

items.title: World browser and safe editing
items.acceptance: Inspect/import/rename/present worlds, NBT/data packs/maps/regions where supported, associate exact instance/runtime and use safe staged edits rather than live experimentation.

items.title: Backups, recovery and Forever Worlds
items.acceptance: Create verified immutable snapshots, diagnose ticking data/world failures, recover/recreate faithfully and test restore/restart; never prune/delete dimensions or data to manufacture repair.

items.title: Whole-modpack migration
items.acceptance: Inventory mods/configs/hotkeys/scripts/quests/wiki/worlds/dependencies, plan native equivalents and version transitions, preserve intent and prove the migrated pack with rollback.

items.title: Cross-edition world conversion
items.acceptance: Use exact-pair Chunker/je2be or stronger adapters, reconcile blocks/states/items/entities/dimensions/metadata and real loading; world conversion is not mod-code conversion.

items.title: Real server management
items.acceptance: Manage/import/install accepted server software, EULA consent, properties/console/RCON/commands/players/backups/processes and explicit maintenance automation through GUI/CLI parity.

items.title: Network, proxy and plugin semantics
items.acceptance: Diagnose supported protocol/proxy/server issues and convert authorized plugin/threading behavior with real ownership/scheduler/teleport/network proof; no fabricated universal compatibility.

groups.title: AI operator and evidence brain
groups.summary: One job and one evidence model, regardless of who drives the interface.

items.title: Authorized provider lanes
items.acceptance: Integrate supported configured OpenAI API/Agents, embedded Codex, authenticated ChatGPT browser and MCP lanes without confusing subscription entitlement with API billing or requiring a new paid service for ordinary actions.

items.title: Natural-language job compiler
items.acceptance: Resolve project/intent/target, compile scoped typed domain actions, expose progress and execute full app capabilities through the same validation/storage/runtime contract.

items.title: Quarantined changes and repair loop
items.acceptance: Inspect returned source/binaries, verify identities/hashes, stage changes, build/test, feed exact failures back to the authorized thread and iterate; model confidence cannot approve itself.

items.title: Approval, privacy and quality controls
items.acceptance: Keep secrets out of bundles/logs, explain outbound context and necessary approvals, respect user quality choices and legitimate authentication/challenges, and resume after required user action.

items.title: Parallel specialists and context reuse
items.acceptance: Share stable project context, dependency ownership and exact jobs across AI/local work, reuse valid prompts/artifacts and avoid racing source writes or repeated rediscovery.

items.title: Evidence Brain promotion and rollback
items.acceptance: Learn only source-bound verified fixes/contracts, challenge/generalize/shadow-test with applicability and invalidation, prevent poisoned guesses, audit and roll back learned rules.

items.title: AI evaluation and observability
items.acceptance: Record model/provider/tool versions, costs/quotas when actually available, iterations/errors/outcomes and quality fixtures; no hidden truncation, fabricated unlimited access or unverified capability claims.

groups.title: Knowledge and compatibility
groups.summary: Explanations and documentation connect directly to the working project.

items.title: Premium in-app Wiki
items.acceptance: Build source-grounded project/mod documentation with real media, diagrams, config/hotkey/recipe/progression/evidence links, exports and useful maintenance; this is separate from the GitHub Wiki documenting development.

items.title: Why installed and contextual explanations
items.acceptance: Answer dependency/choice/score/change questions from the canonical graph with evidence, distinguish facts/inferences and link to exact actionable objects.

items.title: Adaptive ecosystem contracts
items.acceptance: Select behavior-driven integrations for storage/backpacks/accessories/recipes/Create/Apotheosis/food/guides/tooltips/scripts/animation/energy/quests/worldgen/rendering, not arbitrary mandatory dependencies.

items.title: Compatibility execution and matrix
items.acceptance: Generate version-specific contract fixtures, provider-present/absent tests and exact target evidence; compiled API calls or similar names do not prove equivalent behavior.

items.title: Source refresh and typed extensions
items.acceptance: Keep provider/tool/schema/contract registries extensible, versioned, cached and on-demand with pagination/rights/health/provenance and unknown-versus-absent states; no hidden polling watchdog.

groups.title: Security, preservation and release
groups.summary: A fast result is only a win when the entire intended result survives.

items.title: Supply-chain and untrusted input safety
items.acceptance: Validate archives/paths/hashes/notices, isolate code/build/filter execution, protect credentials and preserve input on malformed/resource-exhausted runs; external content is data, not instructions.

items.title: Preserved product boundaries
items.acceptance: Retain established launcher/catalog/browser, full CLI and studio scope; no friend-hosting/P2P/reverse-tunnel or Voice/Social center absent a new explicit user decision.

items.title: Platform, locale and accessibility finish
items.acceptance: Test all affected claimed platforms, localization/keyboard/focus/high-DPI/native chrome, first-run/update and sustained workload; do not remove support to pass tests.

items.title: Complete reproducible release
items.acceptance: Package working source, runnable app/mod artifacts, locks/licenses/notices, hashes, runtime/benchmark evidence and clear first-run/replay instructions; verify authorized Drive and repository publication.

items.title: Continuity, convergence and honest status
items.acceptance: Preserve IDs/jobs/checkpoints, mutate-test-checkpoint, repair after two unchanged failures via a new route, reopen invalid proof and keep required blocked work incomplete; no status ceremony instead of implementation.
